findings.highlight: It's half past seven in the morning.
findings.evidenceJa: 時刻は七時半を過ぎたところだ。
findings.governingReading: The time has just passed 7:30 in the morning.
findings.explanation: Just after half past seven becomes exactly half past seven.

findings.governingReading: Saber says Shirou’s judgment about the opening is naïve or insufficiently rigorous.
findings.explanation: Naïve tactical judgment becomes unrealistic expectations.

findings.highlight: "That goes without saying. I saw you looking away for a brief second that last time. I've only seen you do that maybe one other time, so I thought it was my chance."
findings.evidenceJa: 「言われるまでもない。セイバー、さっき少しだけよそ見をしただろ。セイバーがそんなヘマをやるなんて一日で一回あるかないかだから、ここが勝負所だって踏んだんだが」
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Saber makes such a mistake at most once in a day, so he judged it decisive.
findings.explanation: A lapse rare even once per day becomes one previously observed lapse.

findings.highlight: "However, I must point out that you are much better at discerning the boundaries between life and death than yesterday. As you develop a sense of danger, you will become more able to determine when to fight and strike on your own."
findings.evidenceJa: 「ですが昨日よりは格段に、生き死にの境界線には鋭敏になっていますね。危険を察知する感覚が身に付いてくれば、誰と戦い何を打つべきかは自ずと絞られてきますから」
findings.governingReading: Saber says sharpening danger perception will naturally narrow down whom Shirou should fight and what he should strike.
findings.explanation: Who to fight and what to strike become when to fight and strike.

findings.governingReading: After drinking, Shirou lets out a long breath.
findings.explanation: A large exhalation becomes a deep breath.
